newsitem.title: FRENCH GUIANA: Youths riot in French Guiana, set building ablaze.
newsitem.headline: Youths riot in French Guiana, set building ablaze.

text.p: Striking students set a government building on fire with molotov cocktails early on Friday in a night of rioting in the French Guiana capital Cayenne.
Rioters also set cars on fire, broke windows and sacked stores in the French overseas department on the northeast coast of South America.
Two bank cash machines were destroyed, and local state-owned radio said one youth was injured by rifle shots from a local resident.

During the night, riot police had dispersed several hundred high school student demonstrators with teargas who blocked the central French government office (prefecture) with burning tires and makeshift barricades.
The demonstrators have been on strike for two weeks in protest at poor school conditions.
Dozens of riot police surrounded the Cayenne prefecture building in anticipation of fresh violence, witnesses said.
